sources.title: ForestPack — Areas
sources.scope: Area types, ordered behavior, exclusions, paint and falloff controls. Mixed-era XY/UV restrictions require target-build tests.

sources.title: ForestPack — Image distribution
sources.scope: Distribution image controls, selection modes, candidate limits and collision behavior. Not a disclosure of the exact random generator.

sources.title: ForestPack — Surfaces
sources.scope: Projection modes, normal/altitude/slope controls and prepared surface information.

sources.title: ForestPack — Path distribution
sources.scope: Path input, spacing, vertices, source sequence and tangent-related behavior.

sources.title: ForestPack — Reference distribution
sources.scope: Reference-object and face inputs, transform inheritance and source matching.

sources.title: ForestPack — Particle Flow distribution
sources.scope: Particle Flow as a placement input. This does not establish the design of a Cyrus output transport.

sources.title: ForestPack — Geometry
sources.scope: Source definitions, weights/empty outcomes, dimensions and group behavior.

sources.title: ForestPack — Transform
sources.scope: Transform controls, maps, probability controls and post-placement translation warning.

sources.title: ForestPack — Items Editor
sources.scope: Generate/Custom Edit controls. Does not establish persistent-override guarantees for arbitrary regeneration.

sources.title: ForestPack — Display
sources.scope: Viewport and rendering representations, display limits and output distinctions.

sources.title: ForestPack — Camera
sources.scope: Camera-relative controls and their visible consequences. Not proof that primary-frustum removal is secondary-ray safe.

sources.title: ForestPack — Forest LOD
sources.scope: Alternative-source selection by distance or screen size; not a general mesh-decimation algorithm.

sources.title: ForestPack — Material
sources.scope: Tint controls and material integration responsibilities.

sources.title: ForestPack — Forest Color
sources.scope: Whole-item and element-level material variation.

sources.title: ForestPack — Forest Edge
sources.scope: Element-based boundary behavior and renderer-dependent integration; not general polygon Boolean clipping.

sources.title: ForestPack — Animation
sources.scope: Source-time sampling modes and bounded geometry-sample caching.

sources.title: ForestPack — Effects attributes
sources.scope: Published readable/writable attributes; does not reveal internal memory layout or full private stage order.

sources.title: ForestPack — ForestSet
sources.scope: Reusable collections and role-dependent input behavior.

sources.title: Chaos — V-Ray for 3ds Max SDK documentation entry
sources.scope: An official entry was located, but its usable implementation content was not retrieved. No adapter ABI or capability is inferred from it.

sources.title: Autodesk — 3ds Max API portal
sources.scope: Official SDK entry point. Not an API-by-API concurrency guarantee or renderer integration specification.

sources.title: Autodesk Max 2024 — IPainterCanvasInterface_V5
sources.scope: Stroke lifecycle and hit data; effective radius/strength already include brush modifiers; evaluated-mesh binding warning.

sources.title: Autodesk Max 2024 — Hold
sources.scope: Native Undo transaction interface. Integration still requires a real host test.

sources.title: Autodesk Max 2026 — RestoreObj
sources.scope: Restore/Redo lifecycle and repeated-call requirements. Verify against the actual shipping SDK before compilation.

sources.title: Autodesk Max 2024 — IObjectDisplay2
sources.scope: Modern viewport display interface and shared/per-node preparation boundaries.

sources.title: Autodesk Max 2026 — MainThreadTaskManager
sources.scope: A documented route for posting tasks to the Max main thread in the cited SDK. Does not prove identical availability in Max 2024.

sources.title: ForestPack — Rendering best practice
sources.scope: Renderer-oriented instancing and memory guidance. Not a measured Cyrus benchmark.

sources.title: ForestPack — Effects syntax
sources.scope: Published expression and parameter concepts. Cyrus DSL/schema details remain an independent design.

sources.title: ForestPack — ForestIvy overview
sources.scope: Companion growth product scope only; not an exhaustive Ivy control audit.
